still have not satisfied previous comments from 5/21/26 "Please resubmit permit with required "Electrical Service Requirements Application" that can be located on the City of Winter Park permitting portal"

(1.) GUTTER DOWNSPOUTS MUST BE DIRECTED TOWARDS PROPOSED RETENTION AREAS AND ARE NOT PERMITTED TO DISCHARGE DIRECTLY TO ADJACENT PROPERTIES. (2.) SIDEWALK AND CURB MUST BE INSTALLED/REPAIRED BY CONTRACTOR PER CITY REQUIREMENTS. (3.) STORMWATER RUNOFF GENERATED FROM THE PROPOSED IMPROVEMENT SHALL BE RETAINED ON SITE AS REQUIRED, AND SHALL NOT INTRODUCE ADVERSE IMPACTS TO THE EXISTING DRAINAGE ON THE SURROUNDING PROPERTIES.

Water and Wastewater Utilities Conditions of Approval:
1.	Damage to the City's water and sanitary mains and appurtenances (cleanouts, water meters and valves, etc.) shall be repaired by the City at the cost of the contractor. 
2.	Fees are assessed for a sanitary lateral installation and to abandon the existing lateral. The sewer main and any service laterals shall be inspected after construction (prior to a C/O). 
3.	Protect the valve in the southmost driveway. Contact the Water & Wastewater Utility Department if the valve can needs adjustment. You may contact us at waterwastewater@cityofwinterpark.org. 
4.	The existing water meter is to be utilized. The water meter connection shall be inspected prior to issuance of a CO. 
5.	As part of the City's Cross Connection Control Program and requirements of the Florida Department of Environmental Protection Drinking Water Program, an inspection shall be performed for all permits to randomly verify drinking water customer compliance with the City of Winter Park's Code of Ordinances. A City of Winter Park approved backflow preventer is required on all water services except for limited situations. Close out of the permit or a Certificate of Occupancy will not be issued until the Cross Connection Control Inspection has been approved. Code of Ordinances Section 102.
6.	Changes or deviations to approved plans must be approved by the Water and Wastewater Utilities Department prior to performing the revised work. Proposed changes must be documented immediately describing the proposed changes and sent to the City for approval. Send change requests and documentation to waterwastewater@cityofwinterpark.org. Changes may be incorporated after written approval by the City.

Result.Comments: Please resubmit permit with required "Electrical Service Requirements Application" that can be located on the City of Witner Park permitting portal.
Please provide details for the gravel driveway on the site plan, including the stone material to be used. No recycled materials or limestone is permitted, must be an incompressible, natural stone.

BE ADVISED. Prior to UF RES Arbor final inspection, the following landscape requirements must be met: 
1) 1 approved shade tree(s) must be on the lot, and 
2) 1 approved shade tree(s) must be in the right of way.
*Extant trees may apply. 
*All new shade tree plantings must be 3-inch minimum caliper Florida grade #1. 
*New shade tree plantings must be at least 10ft from any structure.

To ensure there are no utility conflicts, please provide revised site plans along with a narrative response to the comments below to the Building Department.
1.	Note the location of the current, existing water meter and its size.
a.	If a new meter installation is needed, note the location and size of the meter on the site plan.
b.	If the water meter needs to be re-located, note its existing and proposed locations and its size on the site plan.
2.	Note the location of the current, existing sanitary sewer service lateral and its clean outs, if there is one. A cleanout in an area needing to bear a load, e.g. the driveway or sidewalk, will require a brass cap.
a.	If a sewer lateral relocation is necessary, note the existing location and the proposed, new location. If the existing lateral is abandoned, the applicant will be assessed the cost of abandonment.
b.	If a lateral installation is necessary, note the proposed location. 
c.	Lateral installation costs are based on the depth of the sewer main they discharge to.
3.	Provide a survey of drainage, sewer, water, or other utility easement, if applicable.
4.	Lake or canal irrigation and/or well location (irrigation or potable), if applicable.

1. Please provide impervious surface area tabulation breakdown on site plan per Sec 58-65(f)(2)b.
2. Please provide front yard landscape area tabulation breakdown on site plan per Sec 58-65(f)(2)b.
3. Overall height on building elevations must be measured from existing grade. Please adjust accordingly.
4. Please provide a callout of the overall height of the accessory structure measured from existing grade (max 16').
